status: Exploratory comparison retained independently of the now-qualified default-uppercase projection. Other operations and language tailoring remain OPEN.
specifiedSourceRule: SVG character indices are determined before text-transform. Original scalar/UTF-16 addressing must remain distinct from emitted shaping characters.
inputs: Original CC0 controls under ../text-shaping-boundaries/research/; only @font-face is materialized in RAM using the identical shared program.
scope: Exploratory comparison only: one healthy native process per input/host, not reference admission or a library case-mapping contract.
inference: For these inputs the pinned browser output matches the emitted-text-index literal and differs from the source-index literal on both hosts. Its case-transformed screenshot alone cannot establish original-source-index correctness.

findings: Position-list entries are consumed per original scalar and stored at normalized UTF-16 offsets. Mixed direct/path layout concatenates source ranges before applying root lists.
Streaming font coverage consumes normalized reader chunks; retained-instance discovery consumes extracted normalized runs. Both must use the same conversion semantics and emitted scalar coverage.

GlyphLayout sourceLengths describes GSUB consumption in its input string. Lifting original intervals into emitted text preserves this shaping/fitting meaning; zero-length expansion aliases would conflate it.
Source-style default elision also needs the complete anchor comparison; this prerequisite is closed in text-shared-anchor.json.
sharedModelAudit.nextImplementation: Extend context-sensitive operations/language tailoring on the qualified source-to-emitted model; deletion and empty intervals need explicit review before admission.
sharedModelAudit.casingRequirement: CSS uses full Unicode mappings, including applicable context and known-language rules. SpecialCasing supplements simple one-to-one mappings. Reader/element boundaries cannot be treated as new capitalization words. Define the admitted language/character domain explicitly; culture-blind one-to-one conversion is insufficient.

modelResponsibilities: Build SVG position lists and original source diagnostics against original characters; retain a mapping when case conversion changes the emitted sequence.
Font coverage, shaping, spacing and fitting must see the transformed typographic text; keep these responsibilities distinct from original position-list addresses.
Preserve span/node/paint/anchor/absolute-reset boundaries. Do not globally rewrite the source string or admit only unchanged-uppercase documents.
Resolve language-sensitive and admitted-character boundaries explicitly before feature admission. Native literal controls complement the observed browser transformation behavior.
